lines.text: Roll three dice, and line them up from smallest to largest.
lines.caption: Roll three dice, and line them up from smallest to largest.

lines.text: How often is the middle number a two?
lines.caption: How often is the middle number a two?

lines.text: Lots of kids guess one out of six. <short pause> But that's NOT right!
lines.caption: Lots of kids guess one out of six. But that's NOT right!

lines.text: Hi, I'm Vantee! Let's count it out, together.
lines.caption: Hi, I'm Vantee! Let's count it out, together.

lines.text: Here's the question.
lines.caption: Here's the question.

lines.text: Three fair six-sided dice are rolled.
lines.caption: Three fair six-sided dice are rolled.

lines.text: The three numbers are put in order.
lines.caption: The three numbers are put in order.

lines.text: What is the probability that the middle one is a two?
lines.caption: What is the probability that the middle one is a two?

lines.text: Here are the five choices. Take a good look.
lines.caption: Here are the five choices. Take a good look.

lines.text: Say we roll five, two, and one.
lines.caption: Say we roll five, two, and one.

lines.text: Sort them: one, two, five. The middle number is two. That counts!
lines.caption: Sort them: one, two, five. The middle number is two. That counts!

lines.text: Next, take two, six, and two. Sorted: two, two, six. The middle is still two!
lines.caption: Next, take two, six, and two. Sorted: two, two, six. The middle is still two!

lines.text: But three, two, four sorts to two, three, four. The middle is three. No good.
lines.caption: But three, two, four sorts to two, three, four. The middle is three. No good.

lines.text: Let's give the dice colors: red, blue, and green.
lines.caption: Let's give the dice colors: red, blue, and green.

lines.text: Each die has six faces. So the number of rolls is six, times six, times six.
lines.caption: Each die has six faces. So the number of rolls is six, times six, times six.

lines.text: So there are two hundred sixteen rolls. Each one is equally likely.
lines.caption: So there are two hundred sixteen rolls. Each one is equally likely.

lines.text: Now it's your turn. Pause the video and give it a go. I'll wait!
lines.caption: Now it's your turn. Pause the video and give it a go. I'll wait!

lines.text: Welcome back! Our strategy: sort the rolls by how many dice show a two.
lines.caption: Welcome back! Our strategy: sort the rolls by how many dice show a two.

lines.text: First case: exactly one die shows a two.
lines.caption: First case: exactly one die shows a two.

lines.text: For two to be in the middle, one die must be lower, and one higher.
lines.caption: For two to be in the middle, one die must be lower, and one higher.

lines.text: Lower than two? That can only be a one.
lines.caption: Lower than two? That can only be a one.

lines.text: Higher than two? Three, four, five, or six. That's four choices.
lines.caption: Higher than two? Three, four, five, or six. That's four choices.

lines.text: Now, here's the sneaky part. Take one, two, five.
lines.caption: Now, here's the sneaky part. Take one, two, five.

lines.text: The colored dice can show those numbers in six different orders.
lines.caption: The colored dice can show those numbers in six different orders.

lines.text: Six orders, times four choices for the high number.
lines.caption: Six orders, times four choices for the high number.

lines.text: That's twenty-four rolls.
lines.caption: That's twenty-four rolls.

lines.text: Second case: exactly two dice show a two.
lines.caption: Second case: exactly two dice show a two.

lines.text: Sort them, and the middle number is always two.
lines.caption: Sort them, and the middle number is always two.

lines.text: The third die is NOT a two, so it has five choices.
lines.caption: The third die is NOT a two, so it has five choices.

lines.text: And the odd die can be red, blue, or green. That's three spots.
lines.caption: And the odd die can be red, blue, or green. That's three spots.

lines.text: Three spots, times five choices, gives fifteen.
lines.caption: Three spots, times five choices, gives fifteen.

lines.text: Last case: all three dice show two. That's just one roll.
lines.caption: Last case: all three dice show two. That's just one roll.

lines.text: Now add: twenty-four, plus fifteen, plus one. That's forty rolls.
lines.caption: Now add: twenty-four, plus fifteen, plus one. That's forty rolls.

lines.text: So the probability is forty over two hundred sixteen.
lines.caption: So the probability is forty over two hundred sixteen.

lines.text: Divide the top and bottom by eight.
lines.caption: Divide the top and bottom by eight.

lines.text: That gives five over twenty-seven. <short pause> Choice C!
lines.caption: That gives five over twenty-seven. Choice C!

lines.text: Now, here's another way. Call one and two the small numbers.
lines.caption: Now, here's another way. Call one and two the small numbers.

lines.text: The middle is two or less exactly when at least two dice are small.
lines.caption: The middle is two or less exactly when at least two dice are small.

lines.text: Look: one, one, five. Two small dice, so the middle is small.
lines.caption: Look: one, one, five. Two small dice, so the middle is small.

lines.text: Exactly two small: three spots for the big one, times two, times two, times four. Forty-eight rolls.
lines.caption: Exactly two small: three spots for the big one, times two, times two, times four. Forty-eight rolls.

lines.text: All three small: two times two times two. Eight rolls.
lines.caption: All three small: two times two times two. Eight rolls.

lines.text: So fifty-six rolls have a middle of two or less.
lines.caption: So fifty-six rolls have a middle of two or less.

lines.text: Next, subtract the cases where the middle is one.
lines.caption: Next, subtract the cases where the middle is one.

lines.text: The middle number is one exactly when two or more dice land on one.
lines.caption: The middle number is one exactly when two or more dice land on one.

lines.text: Exactly two ones: three spots for the other die, times five choices. Fifteen.
lines.caption: Exactly two ones: three spots for the other die, times five choices. Fifteen.

lines.text: All three ones: just one roll. So sixteen in all.
lines.caption: All three ones: just one roll. So sixteen in all.

lines.text: Fifty-six, minus sixteen. Forty again!
lines.caption: Fifty-six, minus sixteen. Forty again!

lines.text: Now, let's look at the wrong answers. Each one is a trap.
lines.caption: Now, let's look at the wrong answers. Each one is a trap.

lines.text: A is one over nine. That counts only the twenty-four rolls where one die shows two.
lines.caption: A is one over nine. That counts only the twenty-four rolls where one die shows two.

lines.text: Choice B is one over six. That's the chance that one particular die shows a two.
lines.caption: Choice B is one over six. That's the chance that one particular die shows a two.

lines.text: But after sorting, the middle number can come from any die.
lines.caption: But after sorting, the middle number can come from any die.

lines.text: One way to land on D: from fifty-six, subtract only cases like one, one, five.
lines.caption: One way to land on D: from fifty-six, subtract only cases like one, one, five.

lines.text: That's three spots, times four big numbers. Twelve rolls.
lines.caption: That's three spots, times four big numbers. Twelve rolls.

lines.text: It misses one, one, and two. And also one, one, and one.
lines.caption: It misses one, one, and two. And also one, one, and one.

lines.text: One way to land on E: count the forty-eight rolls with exactly two small dice.
lines.caption: One way to land on E: count the forty-eight rolls with exactly two small dice.

lines.text: That includes twelve rolls like one, one, and five. Their middle is one.
lines.caption: That includes twelve rolls like one, one, and five. Their middle is one.

lines.text: And it misses four rolls that DO count: one, two, two, and two, two, two.
lines.caption: And it misses four rolls that DO count: one, two, two, and two, two, two.

lines.text: So here's a great habit. Try some examples, and always sort them first.
lines.caption: So here's a great habit. Try some examples, and always sort them first.

lines.text: Ready for a challenge? Same three dice.
lines.caption: Ready for a challenge? Same three dice.

lines.text: This time, what is the probability that the middle number is a three?
lines.caption: This time, what is the probability that the middle number is a three?

lines.text: Same plan as before: split by how many threes you roll.
lines.caption: Same plan as before: split by how many threes you roll.

lines.text: Pause the video, and go for it!
lines.caption: Pause the video, and go for it!

lines.text: Let's check. First, exactly one die shows a three.
lines.caption: Let's check. First, exactly one die shows a three.

lines.text: Lower: one or two. That's two choices. Higher: four, five, or six. Three choices.
lines.caption: Lower: one or two. That's two choices. Higher: four, five, or six. Three choices.

lines.text: Six orders, times two, times three. Thirty-six rolls.
lines.caption: Six orders, times two, times three. Thirty-six rolls.

lines.text: Exactly two dice show a three: three spots, times five choices. Fifteen.
lines.caption: Exactly two dice show a three: three spots, times five choices. Fifteen.

lines.text: All three dice show three: one roll.
lines.caption: All three dice show three: one roll.

lines.text: Thirty-six, plus fifteen, plus one. That's fifty-two rolls.
lines.caption: Thirty-six, plus fifteen, plus one. That's fifty-two rolls.

lines.text: Fifty-two over two hundred sixteen. Divide both by four.
lines.caption: Fifty-two over two hundred sixteen. Divide both by four.

lines.text: That's thirteen over fifty-four. <short pause> If you got it, amazing work!
lines.caption: That's thirteen over fifty-four. If you got it, amazing work!

lines.text: Here's the big idea to remember.
lines.caption: Here's the big idea to remember.

lines.text: Split the rolls by how many dice show the middle value.
lines.caption: Split the rolls by how many dice show the middle value.

lines.text: Then count the orders in each case. Colored dice help!
lines.caption: Then count the orders in each case. Colored dice help!

lines.text: I'm Vantee. Keep rolling, and I'll see you next time!
lines.caption: I'm Vantee. Keep rolling, and I'll see you next time!
